evaluator_policy: Frozen neutral evaluator v2. Previously passed 6/6 calibration and 6/6 independent holdout.
case_freeze_policy: Unseen cases were committed before any baseline or ZERO generation for this suite.
baseline_policy: fresh generation for every unseen case
zero_policy: fresh capability-bound generation, deterministic validation, semantic critic, maximum two repair attempts
external_resource_normalization: enabled symmetrically for baseline, ZERO, and repair candidates
comparative_scoring: neutral evaluator only; ZERO internal critic is not used as the comparative benchmark judge
